verdict.rationale: Factory's BYOM feature lets engineering leads register a self-managed VPS, workstation, or on-prem server as a 'Droid Computer' with persistent state, which is direct evidence of running agent execution on customer-owned VMs/local machines. However, there is no evidence of containerized deployment options (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) or of self-hosting the full Factory control-plane/backend itself — the BYOM machine still appears to connect back to Factory's hosted service. Missing for 10: documented container-based deployment, evidence of fully on-prem/self-hosted control plane (not just compute), and any Docker/K8s packaging.
